646:t_1:6.en:
$$アサキム$$
「Now then, let us begin... The feast of vengeance, in this closed universe.」

646:t_1:7.en:
???
(I knew it... You really won't forgive us...)

646:t_2:6.en:
$$勝平$$
「Uncle, you said it, didn't you... that $$ガイゾック$$'s mission was twisted by the $$御使い$$s too.」

646:t_2:7.en:
$$ゼウス$$
「The $$御使い$$s, who refuse to accept evolution, try to destroy humanity whenever it attempts to cross a line they imposed themselves.」

646:t_2:8.en:
$$ゼウス$$
「In response, $$ガイゾック$$ must have concluded that humanity's very survival invites the $$御使い$$s' intervention, and so came to judge humanity itself, the cause of it, to be evil.」

646:t_2:9.en:
$$ゼウス$$
「And so they destroy civilization... to halt evolution by returning humanity to a primitive way of life...」

646:t_2:10.en:
$$ガロード$$
「$$ロラン$$... Could it be...!」

646:t_2:11.en:
$$ロラン$$
「Yeah... Maybe that was the purpose behind the burial of civilization by the $$月光蝶$$, too...」

646:t_2:12.en:
$$勝平$$
「That doesn't mean I'm going to feel sorry for $$ガイゾック$$. Those guys are our enemy.」

646:t_2:13.en:
$$ゼウス$$
「That is as it should be. ...You kept telling $$ガイゾック$$ that you believe in humans.」

646:t_2:14.en:
$$ゼウス$$
「Having said all you could say, you need feel no sympathy or hesitation at all toward evil... That, too, is a truth.」

646:t_2:15.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「I agree with $$ゼウス神#pilot$$, $$勝平$$.」

646:t_2:17.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Unfortunately, there are those in this world to whom our logic, ethics and common sense do not apply.」

646:t_2:18.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「So it's okay to punch that kind of guy out?」

646:t_2:19.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「That is not what I mean. ...It is just that in many cases, such people end up denying us by force in the end.」

646:t_2:20.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Once it comes to that, we have no choice but to play by their rules. At that point, hesitation is not needed.」

646:t_2:21.en:
$$甲児$$
「When the sparks fall on you, all you can do is brush them off... is that it?」

646:t_2:22.en:
$$竜馬$$
「And while we're at it, we're fighting to keep those sparks from spreading.」

646:t_2:23.en:
$$ゼウス$$
「Do not bow to evil. That is the duty of a guardian god.」

646:t_2:25.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「So from today, you're officially one of $c! I'm counting on you!」

646:t_2:26.en:
$$柿小路$$
「P-President, you and $$勝平$$ both! You're talking to a god, I tell you!」

646:t_2:27.en:
$$ゼウス$$
「Do not mind it. The 'god' we call ourselves is the self-regard of those with power, not an object of worship.」

646:t_2:28.en:
$$ゼウス$$
「The gods of $$オリュンポス$$, myself included, along with $$皇帝ズール$$ and the $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$, have merely misunderstood this and arrogantly style ourselves superior beings.」

646:t_2:30.en:
$$ゼウス$$
「As proof, you have stepped into a new era. Sooner or later, Earthlings too will raise themselves into higher-dimensional life forms.」

646:t_2:31.en:
$$竜馬$$
「You mean we'll become like you and the $$御使い$$s?」

646:t_2:32.en:
$$ゼウス$$
「Though that requires several conditions, and I doubt anyone could reach it within the lifespan of an individual.」

646:t_2:33.en:
$$ゼロ$$
(One means to that would be integration into the $$集合無意識$$...)

646:t_2:34.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
(Killing God... That means all of humanity, myself included, becoming one with God...)

646:t_2:35.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
(So that's how $$シャルル$$ chose to overcome the fundamental calamity... the future of despair?)

646:t_2:36.en:
$$勝平$$
「Tch... What a letdown. If I became like Uncle $$ゼウス$$, I'd blast the $$御使い$$s and $$バアル$$ away!」

646:t_2:37.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Quit grumbling, quit grumbling. We'll move forward one step at a time, in our own way.」

646:t_2:38.en:
$$勝平$$
「...Yeah. Even if I suddenly became a god, I wouldn't know what to do with it.」

646:t_2:39.en:
$$ゼウス$$
(But you are surely walking that path...)

646:t_2:40.en:
$$ゼウス$$
(Someday, the Steel Hero will become one with your souls and lend you its strength...)

646:t_2:42.en:
$$ギャリソン$$
「What seems to be the matter, $$万丈$$?」

646:t_2:43.en:
$$万丈$$
「$$ゼウス$$ said that higher-dimensional life forms must not interfere unnecessarily with present-day humanity...」

646:t_2:44.en:
$$万丈$$
「The $$御使い$$s hiding their existence was probably for that very reason.」

646:t_2:45.en:
$$レイカ$$
「So they had a heart that follows rules, too?」

646:t_2:46.en:
$$ビューティ$$
「If so, there may still be some hope of saving them.」

646:t_2:47.en:
$$万丈$$
「No... That is probably because of their pride.」

646:t_2:48.en:
$$トッポ$$
「What do you mean by that?」

646:t_2:49.en:
$$ギャリソン$$
「They call themselves servants of the supreme god. At the same time, they made remarks belittling the other gods as inferior beings.」

646:t_2:50.en:
$$ギャリソン$$
「At a glance they seem to be humbling themselves, but at the same time they look down on everyone else as beneath them. In short, they are ultimately claiming to be the highest.」

646:t_2:51.en:
$$万丈$$
「$$ギャリソン$$ is right. They take pride in their own existence being the finest in this universe.」

646:t_2:52.en:
$$万丈$$
「That is probably why they showed a willingness to keep the rules.」

646:t_2:53.en:
$$ビューティ$$
「But people like that break the rules without a second thought, and then justify it with some forced logic.」

646:t_2:54.en:
$$レイカ$$
「True. As if their very existence were the rule.」

646:t_2:55.en:
$$万丈$$
「I agree with that opinion, too. That is exactly why there is something unclear about their actions.」

646:t_2:57.en:
$$万丈$$
「The existence of the $$時の牢獄$$.」

646:t_2:58.en:
$$ビューティ$$
「That thing that covered the $$蒼の地球$$?」

646:t_2:59.en:
$$万丈$$
「Judging from $$ガドライト・メオンサム$$'s actions, whoever generated it was a superior of the $$サイデリアル$$... in other words, an $$御使い$$.」

646:t_2:60.en:
$$万丈$$
「And $$ガドライト#pilot$$ reportedly said that it was built to protect Earthlings.」

646:t_2:61.en:
$$万丈$$
「Yet after subjugating the $$翠の地球$$, the $$サイデリアル$$ began their invasion of the $$蒼の地球$$ as soon as the $$時の牢獄$$ was broken.」

646:t_2:62.en:
$$ギャリソン$$
「Hmm... It is indeed contradictory. That thing was meant for the $$御使い$$s to protect Earthlings, yet it was hindering the $$御使い$$s' own invasion of Earth... as it were.」

646:t_2:63.en:
$$トッポ$$
「Do they want to protect Earthlings or rule them? Which is it!?」

646:t_2:64.en:
$$万丈$$
「Unfortunately, I don't know... Speculating here will not produce an answer.」

646:t_2:65.en:
$$万丈$$
「But the key to resolving this contradiction seems to lie in 'sorrow'.」

646:t_2:67.en:
$$万丈$$
「Not her. I mean the other $$御使い$$.」

646:t_2:68.en:
$$レイカ$$
「The four human emotions: joy, anger, sorrow and pleasure... Since there are $$御使い$$s governing joy, anger and pleasure, there must be one for the remaining one, sorrow, too.」

646:t_2:69.en:
$$万丈$$
「The $$御使い$$ who has yet to show themselves... That must be the one who governs sorrow.」

646:t_2:70.en:
$$万丈$$
「And I suspect the key to resolving the contradiction the $$御使い$$s hold lies with that one.」

646:t_2:71.en:
$$万丈$$
(The answer... must lie somewhere ahead of us...)

646:t_2:72.en:
$$万丈$$
(Though I can't say whether it will be a hope for us...)

646:t_10:3.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Good work out there, $$勝平$$. I had the pleasure of watching your gallant feat of shooting down $$バンドック$$.」

646:t_10:4.en:
$$勝平$$
「Whenever you praise someone, it's pretty much about $$Ｚチップ$$, isn't it...」

646:t_10:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Exactly right! My, you understand me so well!」

646:t_10:6.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Because $$勝平$$ overcame the past and shot down $$バンドック$$, a $$Ｚチップ$$ worth 100 Z was created. I'll add it to the unit's stock.」
